sanskrit: bhagaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇa- -asyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ | pumāṃsaṃ putram ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
english: O Bhaga, with thy most excellent form — in the womb-cavities of this woman — place a male son [there], for her to bring forth in the tenth month.

sanskrit: adhi skanda vīrayasva garbham ā dhehi yonyām | vṛṣāṇaṃ vṛṣṇyāvantaṃ prajāyai tvā nayāmasi ||
english: Mount [her], O Skanda; put forth thy virile power; place the embryo in the womb. A bull-like [son], possessed of bull's vigour — we lead thee [to her] for offspring.

sanskrit: yad veda rājā varuṇo veda devo bṛhaspatiḥ | indro yad vṛtrahā veda taṃ garbhakaraṇaṃ piba ||
english: What king Varuṇa knows, what the god Bṛhaspati knows, what Indra the Vṛtra-slayer knows — that embryo-making [power], drink [of it].

sanskrit: vi jihīṣva bārhatsāme garbhas te yonim ā śayām | dadan te putraṃ devāḥ somapām ubhayāvinam ||
english: Open thyself, O [thou who art] of the Bārhastyasāman; let the embryo lie down into thy womb. The gods shall give thee a son, a drinker of soma, covered with wool on both sides.

sanskrit: somasya tva rtviyena- -upaimi garbhakṛtvane | tatas te putro jāyatāṃ kartavai vīryebhyaḥ ||
english: With the seasonal [rite] of Soma I approach thee for the making of an embryo. From that may a son be born to thee, to accomplish [great] heroic deeds.

sanskrit: jāyasvāgne 'śvatthād asmai kṣatrāyaujase | ugra āpatikād adhi yo vṛkṣām̐ adhirohati ||
english: Be born, O Agni, from the aśvattha [tree], for this [man's] sovereign power and vigour — fierce, from the timber-source, who mounts upon the trees.

sanskrit: vibādhaṃ cit sahamānaṃ tvām agne janayāmasi | jātāṃ janiṣyamāṇāṃ sapatnān pra ṇudasva me ||
english: Even overwhelming the [opposing] obstacle, we generate thee, O Agni. Drive away from me rivals already born and those yet to be born.

sanskrit: aśvatthasyārohasya vṛkṣasyāraṇayeḥ kṛtāḥ | tato jātāya te 'jani vīḍujambhāgnir agnaye ||
english: The fire-drills have been fashioned from the wood of the aśvattha tree that is to be climbed. From that [fire], born for thee, was Vīḍujambha Agni generated for [the rite of] fire.

sanskrit: taṃ jātaṃ jātavedasam ā dadhāmy amartyam | pāvakam agnim ūtaye śucimantaṃ viṣāsahim ||
english: That [Agni] born — Jātavedas, immortal — I establish [on the hearth]: the purifying, brilliant fire, for [our] aid, the vanquisher of poison.

sanskrit: ut tanuṣva dhanuḥ prati muñcasva varma jahi śatrūn vīryā te kṛṇomi | atra radhyantu ya u te sapatnās tvam ekavṛṣo bhava ||
english: Stretch thy bow; put on thy armour; smite [thy] enemies — I fashion thy heroic powers. Let those who are thy rivals submit here; become thou the sole bull [among them].

sanskrit: vṛṣabhaṃ tvā sajātānāṃ sapatnānāṃ viṣāsahim | hantāraṃ śatrūṇāṃ kṛṇmo virājaṃ gopatiṃ gavām ||
english: We make thee the bull among thy kinsmen, the vanquisher of rivals, the slayer of enemies, the sovereign, the lord of cattle.

sanskrit: samudro 'sy apāṃ jyeṣṭha indro deveṣu vṛtrahā | vyāghraṃ siṃhaṃ tvā kṛṇmo damitāraṃ pṛtanyatām ||
english: Thou art the ocean, the foremost of waters; thou art Indra among the gods, the slayer of Vṛtra. We make thee a tiger, a lion, the subduer of those who attack.

sanskrit: indra iva dasyūn adharān kṛṇuṣva- -ugra iva vāto viśṛṇan sapatnān | te śuṣyantv apa dāvād iva- -agneḥ paryavīvarathā enān ||
english: Cast [thy] rivals down as Indra [casts down] the Dasyus; crushing rivals as the fierce wind [does]. Let them wither — as [wood dries] away from a forest fire — thou hast turned [them] away from thyself.

sanskrit: saṃ vṛścaināṃs te śuṣyantu vṛścainān mopajāṃ śiṣaḥ | sapatnān sarvāṃs tṛḍhvā tvam ekavṛṣo bhava ||
english: Cut them down — let them wither when [thou hast] cut them; leave no remnant of them whatsoever. Having pierced all thy rivals, become thou the sole bull [among them].

sanskrit: tvam ugras tvaṃ balī tvam edhi vivācanam | tvaṃ pṛtanyataḥ pūrvaḥ sapatnām̐ ava dūnuṣva ||
english: Be thou fierce; be thou strong; be thou pre-eminent in speech. Be thou first among those who battle; afflict and drive down thy rivals.

sanskrit: asapatnaḥ sapatnahā- -indra ivāriṣṭo akṣitaḥ | adhaḥ sapatnās te padoḥ sarve santv abhiṣṭhitāḥ ||
english: Rivalless, a slayer of rivals — like Indra, uninjured, undiminished — let all thy rivals be beneath thy feet, trodden down.

sanskrit: mlāyantu te khātamūlāḥ sapatnā agnim eṣāṃ nir hvayāmi śarīrāt | haviṣaiṣām api dadhāmi prāṇāṃs tathaibhyo amuciḥ kṛtāḥ ||
english: Let thy rivals wither, their roots dug out; I call forth the fire from their bodies. I deposit their vital breaths into the oblation-offering — thus are the bonds made for them.

sanskrit: abhivardham abhibhavaṃ sapatnakṣayaṇaṃ haviḥ | rāṣṭrāya tubhyaṃ kṛṇmaḥ sapatnebhyaḥ parābhavan ||
english: An oblation that increases [thee], that overpowers, that destroys rivals — we prepare it for [thy] sovereignty, for thy [use], and for the defeat of [thy] rivals.

sanskrit: yo naḥ svo yo araṇo 'rātiyati pūruṣaḥ | idhmasyeva prakṣāyakas tasya moccheṣi kiṃ cana ||
english: The man — whether one of our own or a stranger — who bears hostility toward us: like a kindling-wood layer consumed [by fire], let nothing of him remain.

sanskrit: asapatnam iti dve ||
english: [The formula] "Rivalless" — [applied to] two [verses].
